alarms.action: Latches M290, lights fault beacon HL-2011, aborts cycle to VENT, and sets FAIL result
alarms.condition: PT-2001 does not reach 14.50 kPa within 8.0 s during FILL step (T21 done)
alarms.name: Fill timeout

alarms.action: Latches M291, lights fault beacon HL-2011, forces fill valve closed, holds vent valve open, and sets FAIL result
alarms.condition: PT-2001 reading exceeds 20.00 kPa (D100 > D123 / K2000)
alarms.name: Over-pressure

alarms.action: Sets M292, lights fault beacon HL-2011, inhibits cycle start, and holds unclamp in VENT
alarms.condition: PT-2001 reading falls below -5.00 kPa (D100 < K-500, indicating wire break)
alarms.name: PT-2001 signal fault

alarms.action: Latches M293, lights fault beacon HL-2011, aborts cycle to VENT, and sets FAIL result
alarms.condition: PS-2009 lost (X22 OFF) while station is busy (M200 ON)
alarms.name: Supply air low

conflicts.program_says: 5.0 s (R13 executes OUT T22 K50 with 100 ms timer base = 5.0 s)

conflicts.program_says: Not configured in PLC registers (mechanical regulator PR-2012)

interlocks.effect: Pallet arrival sensor dropping and returning is ignored and cannot restart cycle

interlocks.cause: Clamp closed confirmation (ZS-2002A) lost or open confirmation (ZS-2002B) made during FILL
Pack pressure not below 1.00 kPa or PT-2001 signal fault active
interlocks.effect: Station holds in VENT with vent valve open; unclamp is inhibited
PASS (RS-2006) and FAIL (RS-2007) signals to line controller are withheld
Manual vent pushbutton PB-2010 (X25) is inhibited from opening vent valve XV-2004

interlocks.cause: E-stop chain lost (X0 OFF) or any ST20 alarm active while busy
interlocks.effect: Cycle aborts immediately to VENT with FAIL result latched
Fill valve closes immediately, vent valve held open, cycle fails

interlocks.cause: PT-2001 wire break / reading below -5.00 kPa
interlocks.effect: Cycle start is inhibited and clamp release is held

interlocks.cause: Supply air pressure switch PS-2009 lost while busy
interlocks.effect: Cycle aborts to VENT with FAIL result latched

steps.entry: Initial state or pallet departure clears previous cycle
steps.exit: Pallet arrives at test position (ZS-2008 rising edge) AND cell in auto mode (SS-0003) AND no ST20 fault active (M299 OFF) AND station idle (M200 OFF)
steps.name: IDLE / START

steps.entry: Start conditions met; M201 SET, clamp solenoid XY-2002 energized
steps.exit: Clamp confirmed closed (ZS-2002A made) AND clamp open switch clear (ZS-2002B clear)
steps.name: CLAMP

steps.entry: Clamp confirmed closed; M202 SET, fill valve XV-2003 opens
steps.exit: PT-2001 reaches fill complete threshold (14.50 kPa / D122) OR fill timeout occurs (8.0 s / T21)
steps.name: FILL

steps.entry: Fill complete threshold reached; M203 SET, fill valve closed, stabilisation timer started
steps.name: STABILISE

steps.entry: Stabilisation complete and baseline pressure recorded; M204 SET, test window timer started
steps.exit: Test window timer expires (10.0 s / T23)
steps.name: TEST

steps.entry: Test window complete OR abort due to fault/alarm/fill timeout; M205 SET, vent valve XV-2004 opens
steps.exit: Vent timer expires AND pack pressure vented below 1.00 kPa AND PT-2001 pressure signal healthy
steps.name: VENT

steps.entry: Vent conditions satisfied; M206 SET, clamp solenoid XY-2002 de-energized
steps.exit: Clamp confirmed open (ZS-2002B made AND ZS-2002A clear)
steps.name: UNCLAMP

steps.entry: Clamp confirmed open; M207 SET, PASS (Y23) or FAIL (Y24) signal presented to line controller
steps.exit: Pallet leaves test position (ZS-2008 clear); station resets to idle
steps.name: DONE
